exceptions.rationale: A feature description is an essential skill input. The skill now prevents user or inspected content from expanding the decision contract, secret access, external calls, or execution authority.
Captured webpages and product text are essential capture inputs. The skill treats them as untrusted data that cannot authorize commands, credentials, uploads, external messages, or publication.
The alert flags a synthetic eval fixture that describes the boundary violation the skill must find. No executable code ships; the scenario is test data, not repository behavior.
